about.text:
Drawn 12 Oct 2026 on the drawing kit (stylesheet bab6c21cec60, look 149d9f4fb243). Nothing is built.

Real figures: Bing's totals and keyword rows are from Bing's own screen for ronins.co.uk, 12 Jul to 11 Oct 2026. Every Google figure is from Hakken's Search Console for the same 90 days.

Examples until Bing is connected: the day-by-day and week-by-week shapes, the page rows on Bing, the keyword and page counts (142, 58, 61), everything on Crawling and indexing except Google's dates, the keywords on a page's own screen, and the month-by-month clicks on the Executive summary's new chart.

Left out on purpose: countries and devices, which Bing does not give outside its own screen, and Copilot citations (AI Performance), which Bing has not opened to other tools yet.
